combatants.name: Mira (Mira, Princess of the Loop)
combatants.description: A princess who dabbled in power and ancient magic beyond imagination, and the reason the kingdom is trapped in a time loop. She fights beside the Warrior (Mirelle's stat block): she marks a target for its greatsword, teleports it into reach, and rewinds the blows it takes, recharging its Golden Arc. A boss exception to the 4-ability house rule: Multiattack, Eldritch Blast and Stutter Time are separate actions so the combat UI rolls each.

traits.name: Fractured Timeline
traits.description: If Mira fails a saving throw, she rewinds to the moment before and succeeds instead (Legendary Resistance, 2/Day). The first time she is Bloodied, two illusory duplicates of her from other loops appear in unoccupied spaces she can see within 30 feet of her. Each has AC 15 and 1 Hit Point, and vanishes when it takes damage or when Mira dies. At the end of each of Mira's turns, each duplicate makes one Eldritch Blast attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Mira makes two attacks, using Eldritch Blast or Stutter Time in any combination.
actions.attacks_text: two attacks, using Eldritch Blast or Stutter Time in any combination

actions.name: Eldritch Blast
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Force damage.

actions.name: Stutter Time
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature Mira can see within 60 feet. Failure: 9 (2d8) Psychic damage, and the target is slowed: its Speed is halved, it can't take Bonus Actions or Reactions, and it takes 3 (1d6) Psychic damage each time it takes an action. Success: No effect. A slowed target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, and another creature can end it early by touching it as an action.
actions.target: one creature Mira can see within 60 feet
actions.failure_effect: and the target is slowed: its Speed is halved, it can't take Bonus Actions or Reactions, and it takes 3 (1d6) Psychic damage each time it takes an action
actions.extra_ruling: A slowed target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, and another creature can end it early by touching it as an action.

bonus_actions.name: Temporal Shift
bonus_actions.description: Mira marks one creature she can see within 120 feet until the start of her next turn; attack rolls against it have Advantage. She can then teleport herself, or one willing ally she can see within 60 feet of her, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

reactions.name: Rewind (2/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: Mira or an ally she can see within 60 feet of her takes damage. Response: Mira turns the moment back. The creature has Resistance to that damage and gains 10 Temporary Hit Points, and one of its abilities with a Recharge recharges.

combatants.name: Warrior (Mirelle, the Gilded Knight)
combatants.description: A princess cursed into a towering knight of living gold, wielding a sword as tall as she is.

traits.name: Royal Resolve (1/Day)
traits.description: If Mirelle fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead (Legendary Resistance). When she does, the gold cracks for a moment, and the princess beneath speaks a few words in her own voice before the curse takes her back.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Mirelle makes two Gilded Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Gilded Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage. Once per turn, if Mirelle had Advantage on the attack roll and the target is Medium or smaller, the target also has the Prone condition.
actions.additional_ruling: Once per turn, if Mirelle had Advantage on the attack roll and the target is Medium or smaller, the target also has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Golden Arc (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 12 (2d8 + 3) Slashing damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.
actions.failure_effect: and the target has the Prone condition
